learning_outcomes.text: Capacity for the drafting, signing and development of projects in the field of industrial engineering, whose objective, in accordance with the knowledge acquired as established in section 5 of Order CIN/351/2009 of February 9, is the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or exploitation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Capacity for the management of the activities object of the engineering projects described in the previous heading.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Capacity to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Capacity for handling specifications, regulations and mandatory standards.
Capacity to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Capacity to apply the principles and methods of quality.
Capacity for organization and planning in the business environment, and other institutions and organizations.
Capacity to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding and capacity to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.

teaching_methods: Activities developed during the placements themselves (workday adapted to the circumstances of the collaborating entity and the student)
Monitoring by the academic tutor and the tutor at the collaborating entity

assessment_methods.method: Assessment by the tutor at the collaborating entity
Degree of achievement of the objectives of the placement training project
Content and quality of the final placement report and its presentation and defense

assessment_rules: The academic tutor will assign the grade based on: 50% assessment by the collaborating entity's tutor, 25% achievement of training project objectives, and 25% content and quality of the final report, presentation, and defense. The student must demonstrate learning outcomes through meetings, a final report (including self-assessment), and an oral presentation and defense of the report.
